- Expert mode: keep the ROM's own apps alongside the Google ones, and name the
  output zip yourself
- Save a selection and load it again later, from the picker or the command line
- Export a saved selection and import someone else's
- crDroid's two official package sets are built in as presets
- Digital Key Services is available on the devices that carry it
- The picker tells you when a newer version of this tool is out
- A footer showing the version, how much the download cache is using, and a
  button to clear it
- The download cache moved to one place the tool keeps across versions
- App descriptions no longer get cut off mid-sentence; click a row for the rest
- Linux: the window picker gets a proper launcher entry, so it has a name and
  an icon in the taskbar instead of a placeholder
- Windows: the executable carries an icon
- Fixed a crash when the result dialog showed a long output path
- Fixed a crash while downloading, from two workers reporting progress at once
